title: Start here: why the service exists
summary: This project produces effective, visibly artificial customer-service agents. The AI-romance discussion was an entry point, not the product. A cartoon cat and six earlier human presentations are renderers of the same governed business capability.
invariants: Never equate an entertaining avatar with a completed service action.
Avatar identity and personality are presentation choices, not the authority to fetch or modify business records.
Demonstrate what was actually done; a mere 'request logged' assertion does not imply a follow-up is scheduled.
The existing Intention Service, business providers, playout engine and Storage Fabric remain separately authoritative.
procedure: Resolve the actual business capability and authorization.
Plan evidence-backed speech and screen presentation.
Maintain a continuous call feed; expose verified result, reference or next action.

provenance.claim: Readback six-utterance generation plan, script matching and review limits.
83 source-pinned legacy recovery definitions and review-only candidate policy.
